Remove the stored master password for the current vault from the OS keychain

Usage: kprun deinit [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --db <DB>       Path to the KeePass database (default: KPRUN_DB or ~/.kprun/secrets.kdbx)
      --delete-vault  Also delete the vault file itself (asks for confirmation)
      --yes           Skip the confirmation prompt
  -h, --help          Print help
